## Parent

- Slice 2A implementation plan, section 2.3 and ticket R3; closes the deferred T13 from slice 1: https://github.com/devuser/Lumen/blob/7bbf8a58f8e2b1189fee60bfa0e7075ffac4de2e/docs/research/feed-retrieval-slice2a-plan-2026-07-11.html
- Campaign branch: `feat/feed-retrieval-slice2a`

## What to build

The contract v3 cutover: refs become the only article identity on the JSON boundary. Every feedq envelope stamps `schemaVersion: 3`. Numeric article ids (`articleId`, `article_id`, `id`) are removed from every projection of every surviving command; `article_ref` plus `revision` identify articles. Lookup flags follow: `--id` becomes `--ref` on `articles`, and `coverage` seed resolution accepts a ref or URL only.

`feedq.schema.json` is rewritten: `const: 3` on every response, numeric-id definitions deleted, new retrieve definitions included, so a stale consumer fails schema validation loudly instead of silently reading half-migrated rows.

The pipeline articles adapter follows the v3 shape in the same change (projection only; its internal ref-derived numeric surrogate for the not-yet-deleted note path stays untouched). SKILL.md's contract section is fully rewritten for v3.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No numeric article id appears in any `--json` output of any surviving command (mechanical sweep against live output)
- [ ] Schema validation rejects a v2 payload and accepts live v3 output for every surviving command
- [ ] `articles --ref art-...` works; `--id` is rejected with an actionable error; `coverage` seeds resolve by ref or URL
- [ ] Pipeline adapter and fixture integration tests green against v3 output; feed and pipeline typecheck green
- [ ] SKILL.md contract section rewritten in
